warnings.message: Checks use conservative boxes for catalog solid parts and declared support areas. Curved/hollow parts are approximated. Room-side door access and known inward swings and sampled walking routes are advisory checks; unknown/outward swings are explicitly unassessed. Walking checks use configured probe dimensions and a bounded grid; stability, full headroom clearance, overlapping openings, room-specific rules, budgets, and preservation of authorized previous state are not checked. A passing baseline is not full acceptance.

openness.explanation: 100 × sampled unoccupied floor fraction. Uses the union of standing-height solid projections; this is independent of entrance reachability.

storage.explanation: 100 × V / (V + storage_reference_m3), where V sums nominal outer volumes of standalone storage types. Surface-mounted containers are excluded to avoid rewarding stacked storage twice. This does not establish contents, internal capacity, or accessibility.

workspace.explanation: Best declared desk: 100 × capped worktop width/depth ratios, or zero when height or chair clearance fails the policy. One fitting chair facing the desk is allowed. Does not assess desktop clutter, ergonomics, or entrance-to-desk reachability.

aesthetics.explanation: Room geometry and free-text style do not determine personal taste. No measurable aesthetic preference has been supplied to this scorer.

warnings: Scores are soft planning proxies, not photo fidelity, safety, or permission to remove observed/locked furniture. Geometry and clearance checks remain separate constraints.
Compare scores only under the same policy. Averages use equal weights and are unset if any selected criterion is unassessed.
Storage uses nominal outside volumes, not verified usable capacity. Openness is sampled; aesthetics requires explicit user criteria.
